arguments.summary: Investigated the reasons for the growing failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database. Initiated the export of the failed_jobs table using the pg_dump method due to time constraints. The export is estimated to take approximately 20 minutes.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the export progress and once completed, analyze the data to identify the root cause of the failures. Prioritize resolving the issues to clear the backlog and improve the job execution process.
